aloneHint: ON: AI can only read. OFF: work together with AI.
aloneOn: Taking a moment to think. AI can still read, and you can keep editing.
aloneOff: Ready to think together. Stopped operations will not restart automatically.
deskIdHint: Identifies this open desk; not included in saved files
editBusy: Finish editing before renaming the desk.
lockHint: {{state}}: prevents mouse movement, resizing, and endpoint changes. Double-click editing, properties, and AI operations are still available.
bundleLock: Lock or unlock the whole clip bundle. Locking prevents moving, resizing, adding, peeling, unclipping, and deleting. Text, colors, and AI operations remain available.
